services.name: Museum Admission
services.desc: The Community Artist Exhibition is a new annual program that supports and celebrates creative voices within the artist community. By offering this exhibition, Medalta reinforces its role as a place where heritage and creativity come together to preserve the historic stories of our site while fostering contemporary artistic expression. The initiative opens the Yuill Family Gallery to artists from across Canada, creating opportunities to share new ideas and perspectives beyond Medalta’s regular exhibition programming. The 2027 exhibition marks the first year of the program, with the selected artist helping to inaugurate this new opportunity for artists at Medalta. Our Open Call for Exhibition
